# RevOps Career Coach Skill for Muse

Curated by Skill Harbor — a free, open-source skill (MIT), listed here with credit to its creator @mbfinotti. A career strategist for Revenue Operations and Sales Ops practitioners: it places you on the ladder by scope rather than title, closes competency gaps, manufactures defensible evidence for structurally invisible ops work (baseline → owned intervention → measured delta), and prepares the four exercises real RevOps interview loops run — producing a dated career plan with a gap roadmap, an evidence ledger, interview readiness, and a compensation ask. Candidate side only. Honest notes: built for a discipline with no linear path in — the plan works only if you answer the intake interview honestly; compensation bands come from the skill's reference data — verify against current market data before negotiating; employer-side hiring (role definitions, scorecards, 30-60-90 for new hires) belongs to the sibling skill revops-hiring, not this one. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
